name: btn-cross-arrow

frames.best_why: The resting pill is fully in frame, the arrow sits cleanly inside its white circle, and no cursor overlaps the label.

tagline: A blue Contact me pill with a round arrow badge that crosses on hover.
summary: A wide blue pill reading Contact me, with a white circle at its right holding a small diagonal arrow. On hover the arrow sweeps up and out while a second one slides in from the lower left.
appearance: A wide pill in a navy-to-indigo gradient, edged in pale blue, with white Contact me text at the left. A white circle near the right end holds a small black arrow pointing up and to the right.
behaviour: Hovering lifts the arrow up and right out of its circle while a second arrow rises into view from the lower left, so the two cross for moment. The pill and its label stay still.
use_when: A contact or outbound link wants an arrow affordance and a small lively hover without changing size.
avoid_when: The arrow motion is trapped in a small circle and easy to miss, and it plays on hover only for touch users.
customise: The label, gradient, border and both arrow icons are hardcoded; it takes no props, so edits happen in the file.
weight_why: One pill and two SVG arrows moved by CSS transforms.

a11y.note: The button has real text and keyboard support, but the arrow cross animation plays on hover only.

issues: The signature arrow motion is so brief and small that the frames barely show it.
polish_why: Tidy pill and a neat icon, but the defining motion is subtle and easy to overlook.
